_doc: Acquisition settings readers, one row per source format: the ONE list. Read by the Python dispatcher (read_acquisition_settings_run.py, beside this file) and the Julia gate + version table (omezarr/acquisition.jl). Adding a format = a python/cecelia/utils/<module>.py with `acquisition_settings(path, series=0)` + one row here. docs/todo/MICROSCOPE_PROFILES_PLAN.md
